description: This file defines the IntegerDistribution interface for distributions on integers within the Apache Commons Math library, specifying methods for probability calculations, statistical properties, and sampling.

classes.name: IntegerDistribution
classes.description: Interface for distributions on the integers, providing method signatures for probability functions, cumulative functions, quantiles, statistical measures, support bounds, and sample generation.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Returns the probability P(X = x) for the distribution at the specified point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability P(X <= x) for the distribution at the specified point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability P(x0 < X <= x1), with exception if x0 > x1.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the smallest integer x such that P(X <= x) >= p.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution or NaN if undefined.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution or NaN or infinity if undefined.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support is connected (all integers between bounds are included).

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a single random sample from the distribution.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates an array of random samples of specified size from the distribution.
